# Hunexture

> Hunexture is an Ahmedabad-based software company building custom AI & ML solutions, web and mobile apps, and cloud platforms for startups and enterprises worldwide.

Contact: info@hunexture.com | Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India

## Case studies
- [AI-Powered Analytics Platform](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/ai-powered-analytics-platform/): Enterprise-level analytics platform with machine learning predictions and real-time insights.
- [E-Commerce Mobile App](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/ecommerce-mobile-app/): Cross-platform shopping app with AR product visualization and seamless checkout experience.
- [Cloud Infrastructure Dashboard](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/cloud-infrastructure-dashboard/): Comprehensive monitoring and management dashboard for multi-cloud environments.
- [Healthcare Management System](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/healthcare-management-system/): HIPAA-compliant patient management platform with telemedicine capabilities.
- [Smart Home IoT Platform](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/smart-home-iot-platform/): Intelligent home automation system with voice control and predictive learning.
- [Financial Trading App](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/financial-trading-app/): Real-time trading platform with advanced charting and portfolio management.
- [E-Commerce Digital Marketing Campaign](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/ecommerce-digital-marketing-campaign/): Multi-channel marketing campaign that drove 300% revenue growth for online retailer.
- [FinTech Alpha Dashboard](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/fintech-trading-dashboard/): Real-time cryptocurrency and options trading dashboard with dark-mode optimized charts.
- [Smart Supply Chain Optimizer](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/ai-supply-chain/): Computer vision and predictive modeling system for automated warehouse logistics.
- [Enterprise Knowledge Assistant (RAG)](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/rag-knowledge-assistant/): Chat assistant that answers from company documents with cited sources and role-based access.
- [Support Copilot with AI Agents](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/ai-agent-support-copilot/): Agents that triage tickets, draft replies and take approved actions in the help desk.
- [Telehealth App with FHIR Records](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/telehealth-fhir-app/): Patient app for video visits, prescriptions and records, built on HL7 FHIR.
- [Multi-tenant SaaS Billing Platform](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/saas-billing-platform/): Usage-based billing, invoicing and a customer portal for a B2B software product.
- [Kubernetes Platform and FinOps Dashboard](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/platform-engineering-finops/): Internal platform with self-service environments and cloud cost visibility per team.
- [AI-assisted SEO and Content Engine](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/ai-seo-content-engine/): Topic research, briefs and a publishing workflow that keeps human editors in charge.
- [Visual Quality Inspection on the Line](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/visual-quality-inspection/): Camera-based defect detection for a packaging line, running on edge devices.
- [Voice Agent for Appointment Booking](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/voice-agent-appointments/): Phone assistant that books, moves and cancels appointments in English and Hindi.
- [B2B Wholesale Marketplace](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/b2b-wholesale-marketplace/): Ordering portal with tiered pricing, credit terms and reorder in one click.
- [Contract Lifecycle Portal](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/contract-lifecycle-portal/): Request, review, sign and track contracts with clause search and renewal alerts.
- [Driver App with Proof of Delivery](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/driver-app-proof-of-delivery/): Offline-first app for routes, scanning, photos and signatures.
- [Fitness and Habit Coaching App](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/fitness-habit-app/): Training plans, wearable sync and coach chat in one subscription app.
- [Cloud Data Lakehouse and BI](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/data-lakehouse-analytics/): One governed data platform feeding dashboards, forecasts and AI features.
- [Conversion Rate Optimisation Program](https://hunexture.com/portfolio/conversion-rate-optimisation/): Research-led testing program for a lead-generation website.
